pages.title: Food fortification and biofortification — hidden hunger

facts.text: Global Nutrition Report 2026: ~2.6 billion people cannot afford a healthy diet
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: WHO: India has ~one-third of global undernutrition
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Hidden hunger: deficiency of micronutrients (iron, iodine, zinc, folic acid, vit A, B12, D)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Global: 100+ countries iodise salt (prevented ~750 million goitre cases in 25 years); cereal fortified in 86 countries; oil in 30+
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: India biofortified varieties (2014–2024): 152 — wheat 53, millets 26, maize 24, oilseeds 21, rice 14, pulses 9, amaranth 5
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Examples: iron rice (Philippines), iron pearl millet (India), iron beans (Rwanda)
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Year: 2018; Event: Anemia Mukt Bharat
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline

facts.text: Year: 2019; Event: Pilot — iron, folic acid, vitamin B12
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline

facts.text: Year: March 2024; Event: All custom-milled rice in PDS, ICDS, PM-POSHAN, PMGKAY fortified
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline

facts.text: Year: Till Dec 2028; Event: Extension — ₹17,082 crore
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline

facts.text: Year: Feb 2026; Event: ⚠ Temporarily discontinued under PMGKAY (based on IIT Kharagpur report); not PDS/ICDS/MDM
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline

facts.text: PM-POSHAN: Double Fortified Salt, oil with vitamins A and D, fortified rice
facts.head: Rice fortification timeline
